definitions.gloss: roar; blast; booming sound; thunderous noise
definitions.explanation: An extremely loud sound, originally referring to the sound of an explosion but now commonly used for any deafening noise such as engines, music, or aircraft.

examples.japanese: {爆音|ばくおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: To listen to music at full blast.

examples.japanese: ⟦バイク→バイク：05081_baiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爆音|ばくおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The roar of a motorcycle echoed through the residential area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦闘機|せんとうき}→戦闘機：23287_sentouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爆音|ばくおん}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The windows rattled with the roar of fighter jets.

notes:
USAGE:
{爆音|ばくおん} literally means "explosion sound" but is widely used for any extremely loud noise. In casual speech, it often describes playing music at maximum volume.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆音|ばくおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧ (to listen at full blast)
- {爆音|ばくおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make a thunderous noise)
- {爆音|ばくおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (a roar echoes)
- ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爆音|ばくおん} (roar of an engine)

FORMS:
{爆|ばく} (explosion) + {音|おん} (sound). Compare ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧ (explosion), ⟦{爆弾|ばくだん}→爆弾：10117_bakudan⟧ (bomb).
